## Contribution | 投稿内容

- New skill or update / 新技能或更新：
- Intended users and useful outcome / 适用对象与用途：
- Skill ID and version, if packaged / 技能 ID 与版本（已打包时）：
- Exact submitted files and dependencies/scripts / 本次文件清单与依赖、脚本：
- Original or adapted; sources and existing license notices / 原创或改编、来源与既有许可：
- Chosen public credit / 希望公开的署名：

## Walkthrough evidence | 使用测试证据

Use shareable or synthetic inputs. Do not paste secrets or private transcripts.
使用可公开或虚构的输入，不要粘贴凭证或私密记录。

Tested candidate version/revision / 测试版本：
Date and AI tool/model (if known) / 日期与 AI 工具、模型（如已知）：

| Case / 场景 | Input / 输入 | Expected / 预期 | Observed / 实际 | PASS / FAIL / NOT RUN | Evidence: observed or contributor-reported / 证据：亲自查看或贡献者反馈 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Realistic task / 正常使用 | | | | | |
| Missing input or capability / 缺少输入或能力 | | | | | |

Applicable package checks, commands and actual results / 适用的包检查、命令与实际结果：

Limitations, failed/blocked checks, dependencies not exercised / 限制、失败或受阻检查、未验证的依赖：

If required checks fail or cannot run, mark this PR as **Draft** and explain what help is needed. Do not mark unchecked boxes as passed.
必要检查失败或无法运行时，请标记为 **Draft（草稿）** 并说明需要的帮助，不要把未检查的项目当作通过。

## Public submission check | 公开投稿检查

- [ ] Only intended contribution files and history are included; unrelated local work is excluded. / 仅包含本次投稿文件与历史，不含无关本地工作。
- [ ] Public files were inspected for secrets/private material, and included material is original or authorized with notices preserved. / 已检查公开文件中的凭证与隐私，所含材料为原创或已获授权，并保留既有声明。
- [ ] Test results and limitations describe this submitted revision; any missing checks are explicit. / 测试与限制对应本次版本，未检查项目已明确列出。

## Team review comes next | 等待团队审核

Submission is the first step toward acceptance. The D85 team may request changes, accept, or decline it. Approval, merge, and any website listing are separate team decisions. This PR does not promise website publication.

投稿只是接纳流程的第一步。D85 团队可能要求修改、接受或拒绝。批准、合并与网站收录均由团队另行决定，本 PR 不代表保证上线。
